title: Award badge with letter wave in and out
summary: A white award badge with an accent border sits centred on flat charcoal. A medal icon pops in, then a two-line award label rises letter by letter out of a clip mask, holds, and leaves letter by letter. 3 s, loops cleanly.
use_when: Announcing a ranking, award or launch-day placement on social
A short loop to embed in a post, a site header or the end of a longer film
Milestone posts where one label and one number carry the message
Silent autoplay feeds: no sound or VO needed

look.type_style: bold humanist sans, sentence case, normal tracking; eyebrow ~2.5 % H semibold, label ~4.2 % H bold, both in the accent colour, left-aligned inside the badge

structure.shot: white rounded badge, 69 % W x 15 % H, accent border, centred on charcoal; medal icon left, eyebrow (2 words) over award label (5 words)
structure.camera: static (badge position and size unchanged in every cell and strip frame)
structure.motion: badge on screen from f0, empty until f8; medal scales 0.6 -> 1 + fades in f8-f10, springs.pop (overshoot not measurable); both lines per letter, mask-rise from below with ~10 deg tilt, stagger ~0.5 fr/letter, f9-f24, springs.maskRise; hold f25-f69; exit f70-f81: letters lift and leave the mask left to right, each ~3 fr, easings.inExpo; medal scales to 0 f71-f74; f82-f89 empty badge (loop point)

params.brand: any brand.json: bg for the backdrop, accent for border and text, surface for the badge
params.content.eyebrow: who gives the award or where it happened, 1-3 words
params.content.label: rank + award, <= 6 words, one line at 1:1
params.content.icon: medal / trophy / star glyph left of the text
params.aspect: 1:1 default; 16:9 and 9:16 keep the badge at 69 % of the short side

notes: Measured from 30 fps strips of the source window 0-1 s and 2-3 s: empty badge f0-f7, medal f8-f10, letters f9-f24, hold f25-f69 (45 fr), exit f70-f81, empty f82-f89. Badge 823 x 177 px of 1188, radius ~24 px, border ~5 px accent. Entrance and exit both run left to right; the exit is about as long as the entrance (12 fr vs 15 fr). Proposed terms (not in vocabulary): letter-wave-exit, icon-pop-in. sfx planned by the glue rule, not measured (reference is silent). Palette from palettegen on the 1.50 s keyframe (no cut frames exist); the medal gold is not in the 6 colours.
